about_the_game:
Welcome to Follow Nightmare
Step into a psychological horror universe where every corner hides visceral terror. In Follow Nightmare, you confront a cruel, mysterious antagonist accompanied by nightmarish creatures, each with its own dark story. This gore-filled adventure immerses you in an experience where survival relies on your instinct and personalization.

Key Features:

  • Psychological Horror and Gore: Uncover unique tales through the terrifying stories of monsters haunting this world.

  • Diverse Gameplay: Explore oppressive environments, engage in dynamic shooting mechanics, and manage your time to survive.

  • Unique Customization: Adjust parameters to shape a tailored experience suited to your playstyle.

  • Stunning Graphics: Immerse yourself in a visual universe where every detail enhances the nightmarish atmosphere.

A Terrifying Survival Adventure
In Follow Nightmare, each step brings you closer to secrets or your demise. Explore eerie locations, uncover the origins of the creatures stalking you, and fight to survive in this psychological hell. Will you be brave enough to unravel the mysteries of this world or become the next victim?

Available Edition:

  • Standard Edition: Includes the full game, ready to plunge you into horror.

Prepare to face your deepest fears. Follow Nightmare is more than a game—it’s a descent into the abyss. Add it to your wishlist and dive into the horror now!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains themes and elements that may disturb or shock some players. It includes explicit references to suicide, scenes of cannibalism, and graphic depictions of extreme/gore violence, but no sexual violence or content of that nature is included. These topics are addressed directly and may be unsettling for sensitive audiences. We strongly recommend that players assess their own comfort level with these themes before starting the experience. This content is not suitable for young audiences or those who may be affected by intense themes. If you believe these elements might disturb you, we advise against playing. Your well-being is a priority, and we encourage you to make an informed decision.
